# ✍️ Content Review

## Content location and audience
Page/component, intended player and desired action.

## Accuracy
- [ ] Matches current game behavior.
- [ ] Does not claim unimplemented online play, persistence or backend functionality.
- [ ] Rule numbers match the engine.
- [ ] Links and references resolve.

## Clarity
- [ ] Plain language and concise instructions.
- [ ] Terms match project glossary.
- [ ] Headings and tables are structured.
- [ ] Images have meaningful alt text.

## Localization and accessibility
- [ ] Avoid untranslatable idioms.
- [ ] Text remains readable at zoom.
- [ ] Instructions do not rely only on color.

## Approval
Reviewer, date, requested edits and final verification.
